CSV-EMPTY-CELL-500.title: An accepted CSV empty cell makes its record unreadable
CSV-EMPTY-CELL-500.impact: A normal empty cell becomes a non-finite numeric value that the API cannot serialize. The metadata page then fails.
CSV-EMPTY-CELL-500.retest: Upload a small inventory table with an empty cell, then read the same stored record and metadata page.

ORDINARY-RECORD-DELETE.title: An ordinary account can delete records through the API
ORDINARY-RECORD-DELETE.impact: The API authorizes deletion with the update permission, while the frontend offers deletion only to administrators.
ORDINARY-RECORD-DELETE.retest: The ordinary account must receive a denial before deletion runs; administrator deletion must still work.

PRIVATE-RECORD-SCOPE.title: Record-level private visibility is not enforced
PRIVATE-RECORD-SCOPE.impact: The API accepts and returns private visibility, but an uninvited account can read the record through the API and frontend. The model describes these fields as preparation for access control.
PRIVATE-RECORD-SCOPE.retest: Decide the intended record access policy and enforce it consistently across read, list and mutation paths before relying on this field as a privacy boundary.

MISSING-RECORD-FEEDBACK.title: Missing records produce server errors or blank pages
MISSING-RECORD-FEEDBACK.impact: Missing metadata and user-edit links can return HTTP 500. Missing sample links redirect to an unrelated page, and missing table names produce an empty page.
MISSING-RECORD-FEEDBACK.retest: Unavailable samples, metadata tables and user records should return a clear 404 state.

METADATA-VALIDATION-500.title: Invalid metadata is reported as a server failure
METADATA-VALIDATION-500.impact: Empty batches and malformed CSV input return HTTP 500 instead of input-validation feedback.
METADATA-VALIDATION-500.retest: Reject empty batches and malformed CSV without modifying the record or returning a server error.

TB-CURATION-500.title: A stored TB report fails on absent optional curation metadata
TB-CURATION-500.impact: The stored sample summary cannot render when optional resistance-level display metadata is absent. Existing stored decisions and values are being preserved.
TB-CURATION-500.retest: Open the existing report without creating or changing a curation; its summary and stored decision must render.

TB-NO-AMR-500.title: A stored TB report with a null result cannot be opened
TB-NO-AMR-500.impact: A valid stored null result is treated as a dictionary while building the summary. The read-only report page returns HTTP 500.
TB-NO-AMR-500.retest: Open the stored summary, preserve the null value and display an availability message. Variant-page and curation-write workflows remain excluded.
